title: Services agreement
who: Anyone who does work for another business or person for a fee: consultants, studios, freelancers, small agencies.
summary: A full agreement for work one person or business does for another: scope, fees, term, ownership, confidentiality, liability and how it ends.

title: Mutual non-disclosure agreement
who: Two businesses or people who are about to share private information to explore a deal, a partnership or a project.
summary: Two sides share private information and each agrees to protect the other’s: what counts, what they may do with it, how long it lasts.

title: Independent contractor agreement
who: A business that hires an independent contractor for a defined piece of work, and the contractor doing it.
summary: An agreement between a company and an independent contractor: the work, pay, independence, ownership of what is made, confidentiality and ending.

title: Vendor agreement
who: A business buying goods or services from a supplier on a continuing basis, and the supplier agreeing to deliver them.
summary: An agreement under which a vendor supplies goods or services to a company: orders, delivery, pricing, quality, payment, insurance and ending.

title: Statement of work
who: An agency or freelancer and a client agreeing exactly what will be delivered, by when, for how much, under an existing or standalone agreement.
summary: A detailed statement of work: objectives, scope, deliverables with dates, assumptions, acceptance, fees by milestone and change control.

title: Photo and media release
who: A photographer, organization or business that takes photos or video of people and wants clear permission for where they are used.
summary: Permission to take and use photos or video of a person, with choices about where they appear and a way to withdraw.

title: Permission slip
who: A school, club or group that takes children on a trip or activity and needs a parent’s or guardian’s consent and emergency details.
summary: A parent or guardian gives permission for a child to take part in a trip or activity, with health notes and emergency contacts.

title: Event waiver
who: An organizer of a sports event, class, workshop or activity where participants accept the normal risks and agree to the rules.
summary: A participant acknowledges the risks of an activity, agrees to follow the rules and confirms their emergency contact.

title: Media consent for a minor
who: A school, club or charity that wants to photograph or film children and needs the parent’s or guardian’s informed, specific permission.
summary: A parent or guardian chooses where photos and video of their child may be used, with safeguards and a clear way to withdraw.

title: Consent to treatment
who: A coach, therapist, clinic, studio or practitioner who wants a client’s informed agreement to a service before it begins.
summary: A client agrees to a service after reading what it is, what to expect, how their information is handled and how to stop.

title: Client intake form
who: Any practice or service that collects a new client’s details, history and agreement before a first appointment.
summary: The details and agreement a new client gives before a first appointment: contact, background, goals, emergency contact and how their data is used.

title: Volunteer agreement
who: A charity, school, club or event that relies on volunteers and wants role, expectations, confidentiality and safety written down.
summary: An agreement between an organization and a volunteer: the role, what each side commits to, confidentiality, safety, and how it ends.

title: Offer letter
who: An employer making a job offer, and a candidate accepting it by signing.
summary: A full offer of employment: role, start date, pay, hours, benefits, conditions, notice and confidentiality, accepted by signing.

title: Non-solicitation acknowledgement
who: An employer and an employee who want to record, in plain words, an agreement not to recruit each other’s people or take its customers.
summary: An employee acknowledges and agrees not to solicit the company’s customers or colleagues for a set period after leaving.

title: Employee onboarding pack
who: An employer welcoming a new starter: handbook, confidentiality, equipment, payroll details and first-day information in one packet to sign.
summary: One packet for a new starter, in several parts: welcome, handbook, confidentiality, equipment, payroll details and first-day information.

title: Rental application
who: A landlord or property manager collecting an applicant’s details, income, history and permission to run checks.
summary: An applicant gives their details, address and income history, references and permission for the landlord to check what they have written.

title: Lease addendum
who: A landlord and tenant adding or changing a term of an existing lease: pets, parking, rent date, guests, repairs or something else.
summary: An addendum that changes an existing lease on one subject, with its terms, start date and what stays the same, signed by both sides.

title: Invoice approval
who: A business that needs a named person to approve an invoice before it is paid, with a record of who decided and when.
summary: A record of an invoice, what it is for, and the approver’s decision, signed by the person who sent it and the person who approved it.

title: Change order
who: A provider and client changing the scope, price or finish date of work that is already agreed.
summary: A written change to an existing agreement: what is changing, how the cost and time were worked out, and the new total and finish date.

title: Equipment loan agreement
who: A business, school or person lending equipment to another, with its condition recorded and what happens if it is lost or damaged.
summary: A lender lends an item to a borrower: description and condition, how it may be used, return date and who pays if it is lost or damaged.

title: Referral agreement
who: A business that rewards another person or business for introducing customers.
summary: A company agrees to reward a referrer when a person they introduce becomes a customer: what counts, the reward, when it is paid and the rules.

title: Mutual release
who: Two people or businesses settling a matter and agreeing not to bring claims against each other about it.
summary: Two sides settle a matter and release each other from claims about it, with what is settled, any payment, and what is not released.

title: Payment plan agreement
who: A business and a customer agreeing to settle a balance in installments, with the first payment taken securely before signing.
summary: A customer agrees to pay an outstanding balance in installments: the amount, the schedule, what happens if one is missed, and the first payment.

title: Deposit agreement
who: A business or landlord taking a deposit to hold something for a customer, and saying when it is refunded or kept.
summary: A customer pays a deposit to hold a booking, item or place: what it holds, when it is refunded, when it is kept, and the card payment.
